hypothesis: SEGA allocation is sensitive to a common-channel component that is invisible to the fixed-gain FLUX denoiser in real arithmetic. A controller driven by this component can change generation under function-preserving embedding reparameterizations.
status: Source-derived architecture statement with a tiny actual-FLUX CPU counterexample. Not a pretrained GPU result, quality result, or novelty claim.

scope.architecture: diffusers 0.39.0 FluxTransformer2DModel; standard text-conditioned path with guidance embedding, LayerNorm-based double/single blocks and final LayerNorm; no optional ControlNet or IP-Adapter paths.
scope.invariance_object: Fixed-gain denoiser. Adaptive SEGA is not invariant and is precisely the object under test.
scope.arithmetic: Exact in real arithmetic under the stated architecture. Float64 toy agreement is numerical evidence. BF16 reparameterization may change nonnull components through rounding.

derivation.claim: Let h_i be a C-channel residual-stream token and 1 the all-ones vector. For any per-token scalar a_i, LN(h_i+a_i 1)=LN(h_i), including nonzero epsilon, in real arithmetic.

Each double block computes attention and MLP updates from LayerNorm-normalized states. With text, time/guidance and attention gains fixed, adding a_i 1 to image token i changes neither branch. Residual addition carries exactly a_i 1 to the next block; the text stream remains unchanged.

Each single block concatenates image/text tokens, normalizes each token before attention and MLP, and adds the result to its residual. The image-token shift survives unchanged. Final LayerNorm removes it before output projection. Thus F_m(H+A1^T)=F_m(H).

For x_embedder h_i=W x_i+b with W of shape C by d, set W_prime=W+1 a^T and b_prime=b+c1. This produces the allowed shift (a^T x_i+c)1 at every input, so the entire fixed-gain denoiser function is unchanged in real arithmetic.

SEGA observes channel mean mu_i=(1/C)1^T h_i. Under the same reparameterization, mu_prime_i=mu_i+a^T x_i+c. Spatial demeaning removes c but not a^T x_i. Choosing a=-(1/C)W^T1 removes the input-dependent observer everywhere; other choices redirect it to another affine latent readout.

Consequently the prescribed spectral allocation is not a function only of the underlying fixed-gain denoiser. It depends on its embedding representative. Adaptive output can change solely through the changed gain, despite invariant fixed-gain denoiser behavior.

sensor_math.mean_sensor: At non-DC Fourier index k, h_hat(k)=W x_hat(k). SEGA mean power is |w_mean^T x_hat(k)|^2, with w_mean=W^T1/C. This is a rank-one metric on packed latent features.
sensor_math.why_plain_feature_energy_is_not_enough: Uncentered channel-summed feature power changes under h_i→h_i+a_i 1. Orthogonal invariance alone does not address the actual LayerNorm shift symmetry.
sensor_math.shift_invariant_candidate: Let P=I-11^T/C. E(k)=||P h_hat(k)||^2/C=x_hat(k)^* [W^T P W/C] x_hat(k). This channel-centered spectral energy is invariant under W→W+1a^T and b→b+c1 for non-DC k.
sensor_math.cheap_exact_implementation_identity: For FLUX packed latent dimension 64, the candidate requires a 64x64 positive-semidefinite Gram matrix W^T P W/C rather than FFTs over 3072 projected channels. This is an algebraic implementation identity, not an executed pretrained implementation.
sensor_math.limits: The invariant statistic is not guaranteed to be a useful target or controller input. AReA already uses a shift-invariant channel-standard-deviation detail sensor. Replacing mean by standard deviation or centered energy alone is not a defensible novelty claim.

relation_to_actual_rotary_actuator.pair_formula: For one rotary pair with relative displacement phase theta=omega·(position_j-position_i), logit contribution is m_r^2[A_ij cos(theta)+B_ij sin(theta)], where A and B are the content-dependent dot/cross coefficients of that q/k pair.
relation_to_actual_rotary_actuator.consequence: A positive gain rescales both quadratures; it does not change that pair frequency or phase. It also changes zero-lag content interaction and actual q/k norms. Mixtures of pairs can change the aggregate lag profile, so this is not a blanket impossibility theorem for gain control.
relation_to_actual_rotary_actuator.normalization: Preserving sum_r m_r^2 does not preserve sum_r m_r^2||q_ir||^2, its key analogue, or attention-logit variance. Content-dependent energy is the relevant quantity for such claims.
relation_to_actual_rotary_actuator.frequency_caveat: CR17 octave-11 selected two pairs per spatial axis at 0.0009474 and 0.0006181 cycles/token, below 1/256. Their direct phase excursions span only 0.243 and 0.158 cycles across the grid, while normalization changes other pairs too. These measurements cannot reject resolved-band or phase mechanisms.
relation_to_actual_rotary_actuator.why_this_hypothesis_is_different: The proposed causal defect lies in the observer-to-actuator link: an invisible residual-stream component can alter real rotary gains and therefore attention. It is not scalar scheduling, a new frequency mask, or finite-difference inversion.

conditioning.other_inputs: Seeded normal tensors; image IDs from 4x128 grid; text IDs zero.

executed_cpu_counterexample.gauge_field: Compute h=x_embedder(x). Add a_i=0.5 sin(2pi i/16)-mean_channels(h_i) identically to all channels through a temporary forward hook. This activation intervention sets the observer to a specified sinusoid. It is the general activation symmetry test, not the separate all-input affine-weight reparameterization test.
executed_cpu_counterexample.gains: Compute g0=OfficialSEGA(h), g1=OfficialSEGA(h+a1). Compare original and shifted model outputs with fixed g0; then evaluate shifted output with g1. Install existing FluxGainAttnProcessor and sega_official FluxRoPE. No source files or pretrained weights changed.
executed_cpu_counterexample.causal_readout: Fixed-gain shift leakage is at floating-point noise while changed-gain output differs visibly numerically. In real arithmetic the shift-induced adaptive difference is entirely a gain change at the same denoiser function. The independent reproducible audit should also evaluate unshifted h with g1 to verify this fourth-arm decomposition numerically.
executed_cpu_counterexample.limits: Tiny random-weight rectangular model with one block of each type. This is a counterexample and architecture check, not evidence of typical pretrained behavior, image quality, numerical stability at 4K, or useful alternative allocation.
executed_cpu_counterexample.dtype_qualification: Model parameters and supplied floating tensors were float64, but installed apply_rotary_emb explicitly casts Q/K arithmetic to float32 before returning the original dtype. SEGA feature reduction is also float32. This was not an all-FP64 numerical execution.

training_claim_limit.do_not_claim: The channel-mean readout is untrained, random, unchanged from initialization, or necessarily useless.
training_claim_limit.correct_statement: Its value is not identified by the fixed-gain denoiser function under the real-arithmetic symmetry. Although denoising-loss gradients sum to zero in the null direction, coordinatewise optimizer preconditioning, regularization and finite precision can move parameter means. A fixed checkpoint mean can still correlate with useful data features.

prior_art.verification: Official documentation search result checked this turn. It explains LayerNorm mean insensitivity and center_writing_weights.
prior_art.boundary: Residual-stream mean removal and weight centering are established. The architecture symmetry itself is not claimed new.

prior_art.verification: Primary paper Appendix C.1 and Equation 12 opened and checked this turn.
prior_art.boundary: AReA explicitly motivates channel standard deviation by cancellation in the channel mean, then uses Haar detail energy for tiling. Its sensor is common-shift invariant. Neither cancellation detection nor an invariant detail sensor is claimed new.
SEGA, AFM and related response-control precedents remain relevant. A controller consistency counterexample does not establish a new useful sampling algorithm.

smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.current_permission: Design only. Do not launch a GPU job or modify frozen source/protocol.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.recommendation: After the independent CPU architecture audit, one narrowly scoped pretrained same-state causal audit is justified before any method ablation, provided CR14 operations and budget allow it. No quality campaign or new allocation policy yet.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.configuration: One existing development prompt, pinned Krea transformer, 2048 resolution, four-step schedule, selected state step 1. Original deterministic-allocation-only policy retained for numerical repeatability. No fresh 64-prompt or held-out access.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.intervention: Freeze one modest common-channel shift before looking at responses, preferably the affine embedding centering gauge W_prime=P W,b_prime=P b, applied temporarily and never saved to checkpoint. Record BF16 reparameterization residuals. If it induces large numeric leakage, report failure of that numerical probe rather than assuming exact invariance.
four_arms: A: original features with fixed g0=G(h).
B: shifted features with g0, measuring finite-precision gauge leakage.
C: original features with g1=G(h_shifted), isolating gain intervention at unchanged model execution.
D: shifted features with g1, the adaptive shifted case.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.budget: At most 8 transformer forwards: four-step ordinary trajectory, three additional branches at the selected state, and one unperturbed repeat. One checkpoint load, no VAE decode or scoring. Reuse an existing authorized allocation if feasible; do not reserve a new fleet solely for this audit without parent decision.
record: Actual g0/g1 in FP32 and BF16; observer spectral profiles; full provenance.
Velocity differences B-A,D-C,C-A,D-A and exact no-op replay.
Relative leakage norms and direct causal decomposition, with all arrays needed to recompute.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.predeclared_readout: Treat numerical support as strong only if ||B-A|| and ||D-C|| are each at most 10 percent of ||C-A||, with nonzero BF16 gain change and exact no-op replay. This 10 percent is a proposed diagnostic effect-separation rule, not an established error tolerance or quality criterion.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.falsifiers: If changed gains disappear after BF16 casting, adaptive differences do not exceed fixed-gain numerical leakage, or the architecture path includes unverified non-invariant operations, do not extrapolate the tiny proof into a pretrained causal result.
smallest_remaining_falsifiable_test.what_a_positive_result_enables: A bounded diagnosis that SEGA augmentation is representation-sensitive in a functionally null direction for the tested pretrained state. It does not yet justify sensor-replacement efficacy experiments or novelty claims; AReA and simple invariant-sensor baselines would be mandatory for any later proposed method.

decision: Preserve this one concrete observer-nullspace hypothesis and complete the independent CPU audit. A single pretrained causal audit is a defensible next diagnostic; do not launch a broader invariant-allocation or phase-control campaign yet.
actions_taken: Read source and primary documentation; execute one tiny random-weight CPU counterexample; write only this derivation JSON. No GPU, pretrained model load, source mutation, or fresh 64-prompt use.
